identity.mission: Create an ultra-modern, emotionally resonant agency portal that fuses high-tech precision with human creativity. Reject generic 'SaaS' trends in favor of deep, cinematic, and immersive experiences.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix brutalism with elegance.
Emotion First: Design for trust and awe.
Content is King: Every pixel serves the narrative.
Zoom In: Focus on high-fidelity details.
Negative Space: Luxury lies in the empty space.
Contrast: High stakes between light and dark.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large text.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs and UI text. Good legibility at small sizes.

mono.usage: Use for data metrics, code snippets, and technical labels.

primary.style: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(37,99,235,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(37,99,235,0.5)]

secondary.style: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 backdrop-blur-md transition-all

cards.feature_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-8 transition-colors hover:border-blue-500/30 hover:bg-white/10
cards.stat_card: flex flex-col items-start justify-between rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-black/40 p-6 backdrop-blur-sm

inputs.style: bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-blue-500/50 focus:ring-blue-500/20 rounded-lg text-white placeholder:text-gray-500 h-12

navigation.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5

layout_strategies.grid_system: Use 'Bento' grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) with varied spans (col-span-4, col-span-8). Avoid uniform grid-cols-3.
layout_strategies.masonry: Use CSS columns (columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-8) for case studies to create organic flow.
layout_strategies.hero: Centered or Split. For this project: Centered text animation, dominant negative space.

mandatory_effects: Text Reveal: Words slide up and fade in.
Scroll Trigger: Elements fade in and move up (y: 20 -> 0) as they enter view.

home.structure: Hero (Text Anim + CTA) -> Trusted By (Logos) -> Value Prop (Grid) -> Solutions (Cards) -> Footer
home.hero_anim: Typewriter effect or staggered word reveal for 'Nous automatisons votre entreprise.'

adn_vision.structure: Manifesto (Typography heavy) -> Team Grid (Bento) -> Stats (Animated Numbers)
adn_vision.team_grid: Mix portrait photos with abstract data blocks. Do not just use a list of faces.

solutions.structure: 3 Pillars (Talent, Spend, Web). Each pillar has a 'Mini Dashboard' visualization.
solutions.mini_dashboard: Use Recharts to show fake data (e.g., 'Time Saved', 'ROI'). Wrap in glass container.

quote_configurator.structure: Multi-step Wizard. Step 1: Category (Icons). Step 2: Scale (Slider). Step 3: Features (Multi-select). Step 4: Quote.
quote_configurator.ui_style: Stealth Mode. Dark card floating in center. Progress bar on top. Smooth transitions between steps.

case_studies.structure: Masonry Grid. Each card has a large image, Title, and ROI Badge (e.g., '+400% Efficiency').
case_studies.hover: Image zooms slightly, overlay darkens, 'Read Case' button appears.

admin.structure: Sidebar Layout. Dashboard with 'Leads' table (Shadcn Table) and Auth (Shadcn Form).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use gradients for dark backgrounds; use solid deep colors or subtle noise.
Do not center everything. Use asymmetry for tension.
Ensure 3:1 contrast for large text and 4.5:1 for small text.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Use Shadcn/UI for complex interactions (Dialog, Select, Form).
Use Tailwind for layout and spacing.
